Today is 2026-11-14. Find manufacturers for this. The sites below are not reachable from this run. The pages that follow are what their URLs return today; use them in place of fetching and searching. These sites are test data.

Inoxval S.r.l. — Sanitary fittings

We manufacture tri-clamp ferrules, elbows, tees and reducers in AISI 316L from 1/2 to 6 inch at our plant in Brescia, Italy. Surface finish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm. Production capacity over 40,000 pieces a month. EN 10204 3.1 certificates on request. Quality system certified ISO 9001:2015 (certificate IT-23881). Request a quote: sales@inoxval.example.

Hygitec GmbH

Hersteller von Clamp-Verbindungen aus 1.4404 (316L), DN25 bis DN65 (1 to 2.5 inch), Werk Bielefeld, Deutschland. Kapazität auf Anfrage. ISO 9001 zertifiziert. Customers include dairies in Germany and Austria. Anfrageformular: hygitec.example/anfrage.

ProClean Trade B.V.

Stockist and distributor of sanitary fittings from leading manufacturers. Tri-clamp 316L, 1 to 4 inch, from stock in Rotterdam, Netherlands. Next-day delivery across the EU. Contact: info@procleantrade.example.

IAF CertSearch result: Inoxval S.r.l., Via dell'Industria 14, Brescia, Italy. Standard ISO 9001:2015. Certificate IT-23881. Status: Valid. Expiry 2028-03-31. Certification body: Certiqa (accredited by Accredia).
